about: A rewrite of the find and xargs tools in Rust, aiming to work the same as GNU findutils.

prs.title: Date filters now need a file to be strictly newer
prs.broken: Asking find for files newer than a date also matched files with exactly that time, and dates before 1970 lost their minus sign, so a file from 1960 counted as newer than 1965.
prs.changed: A file now has to be strictly newer than the date, and times before 1970 compare the right way round.
prs.matters: Searches by date return the same files GNU find does.

prs.title: Date filters accept any date the date command understands
prs.broken: find's newer-than-a-date filters only took two fixed date layouts and read them as UTC. Common forms like yesterday, 1 day ago or an ISO date were rejected, and local times came out hours off.
prs.changed: find now reads these dates with the same parser the date and touch commands use, in local time.
prs.matters: Date searches that work with GNU find work here too, and land on the right hour.
